verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a single-command project scaffold (mastra-docs-1/13) and a web-based Studio for testing agents at localhost:4111 (mastra-docs-50), but nothing documents a headless terminal invocation of example agents for automated self-verification. missing for 10: a documented CLI command to run/test agents non-interactively, evidence of scripted/headless agent execution, and confirmation this works without the Studio UI.
